domain: General Statistics & Data Science (data integration, record linkage and entity resolution)

distractor_reasons.pit_2026_counts_by_coc.csv: the region's 2026 point-in-time count by Continuum, people sheltered and unsheltered on the night of 28 January 2026; a one-night count, not the FY2026 people served that policy RF-2027 section 2 splits the fund on, so no figure reads it
distractor_reasons.hic_2026_inventory.xlsx: the 2026 housing inventory count, each project's beds and units on that night; a capacity inventory that no people-served count, night or wait is computed from

wrong_basis_distractors.pit_2026_counts_by_coc.csv: ranks the Continuums by one night's count; ruled out by RF-2027 section 2, which splits the fund in proportion to the people each recipient served in FY2026

sources.constructed: every file is constructed for this task by its generator (task486/generator); the Halvering Valley region, its counties, Continuums of Care, the Homeless Data Partnership, the coalition, the clinic, the outreach team, the State Data Linkage Unit, their staff and every record and number in the files are fictional
sources.public_specifications: the HMIS files follow the HUD HMIS CSV layout and the HMIS Data Standards' project types, relationship, date-of-birth quality and destination codes (FY2024, and FY2022 for one vendor); the clinic's housing statuses are HRSA's UDS categories; the pair file follows the layout a privacy-preserving linkage service returns (per-field agreement codes and Fellegi-Sunter style scores)
